items.headline: What Albemarle (ALB)'s Profits Rebound and Higher 2026 Outlook Means For Shareholders
items.snippet: The sharp Q2 2026 earnings rebound and reaffirmed US$5.7 billion to US$6.0 billion sales outlook support the near term earnings recovery catalyst, while prolonged low lithium pricing and oversupply remain the most immediate risk.

items.headline: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Albemarle, Sociedad Quimica and Rio Tinto
items.snippet: ALB expects lithium demand to witness a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10-20% from 2025 to 2030. Stationary storage is expected to be a significant driver for lithium demand along with EVs.

items.headline: Albemarle Stock Slides 28% in 3 Months: Should You Buy the Dip?
items.snippet: Given the pullback in Albemarle's shares, investors might be tempted to snap up the stock. Lithium demand is expected to grow on the back of significant global EV penetration.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation - Albemarle Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
items.snippet: Sales volumes are expected to be in the range of 225 to 235 kilotons lithium carbonate equivalent, as increased Wodgina volumes partially offset a delay in the Talison CGP3 ramp due to a fire that occurred on June 9.
